summary:
Batch 6 dark-mode brandFg contrast rollout verified on DynoPay preview. Logged in as hostbay@moxx.co (read-only). Dashboard landed in dark mode (body bg rgb(8,8,10)). Verified brand indigo #818CF8 (rgb(129,140,248)) renders broadly across app chrome (Dashboard 103 elements, Transactions 53, Invoices 79, Create-Pay-Link 50). Stray raw #4F46E5 counts on migrated app-chrome pages are 0–5, consistent with intentionally-left filled-button backgrounds/known exceptions (batch 6 targets TEXT/ICON/SPINNER color only). /pay/demo has its own local theme toggle and rendered #4F46E5 correctly in its default light state (secure-payment shield + text and stepper visible & readable). No color-related console errors — only pre-existing MUI validateDOMNesting warnings (

inside

) in CompanySettingsDialog, unrelated to this batch.

ui_bugs.issue: [data-testid='tx-fiat-value'] first matched element returned computed color rgb(255,255,255) (white) in dark mode instead of brand #818CF8. Could be an empty/zero-row rendering — needs manual verification with an actual non-empty transaction row.

action_items: Manually confirm [data-testid='tx-fiat-value'] renders brand indigo (#818CF8 dark / #4F46E5 light) on a Transactions row that has a non-zero fiat amount — automated snapshot found the first element as white (possibly empty-state).

Optional: audit the 4-5 residual raw rgb(79,70,229) usages on Invoices and Create-Pay-Link to confirm they are filled-button backgrounds (out-of-scope for batch 6) and not missed text/icon/spinner instances.

critical_code_review_comments: Batch 6 pattern (brandFg(isDark) helper) is applied broadly and consistently — dashboards and lists show only #818CF8 (dark) or #4F46E5 (light) as expected.
Public /pay/demo maintains its own theme system independent of authenticated app theme toggle — worth documenting this behaviour.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (5/6 checklist items visually confirmed; light-mode regression on authenticated chrome not verified due to inability to locate theme-toggle-button on the logged-in layout in this run)

context_for_next_testing_agent: App lands in DARK by default for this user. [data-testid='theme-toggle-button'] was NOT found on logged-in app-chrome in this run — it may be under a different selector (e.g. header icon-button without that testid) or only in /pay/demo. To verify LIGHT-mode regression on authenticated pages, either find the correct toggle selector (inspect header top-right icon buttons) or set the theme via context/localStorage before load. Brand color verification approach: page.evaluate scanning getComputedStyle(el).color across all elements for rgb(79,70,229) vs rgb(129,140,248) worked well and is the recommended pattern.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bug reproduced. The one MEDIUM finding (tx-fiat-value=white) is inconclusive without inspecting the actual DOM row content; likely a legitimate empty/N/A state rather than a migration miss.
